benbyr_accept_2.m: I happen to know that there are eight of his sheep in total, and they should all be to the northwest of here.

benbyr_accept_3.m: Return to me with proof that you have slain all eight of them.

benbyr_complete_1.m: Hello again. We sure showed that bastard Tinlyn. That should teach him not to mess with me again.

benbyr_complete_2.m: This is a glorious day indeed! Tinlyn should have known not to mess with me!

benbyr_complete_3.m: As for you my friend, seek out my friends in Brightport. I am sure they would extend their hospitality to you.

benbyr_decline_1.m: Very well, but remember that I have my eyes on you ... adventurer.

benbyr_declined.m: I have nothing more to say to you. Leave me.

benbyr_guild03_1.m: (This man seems to be immersed in his thoughts)
r: Hi. Have you heard about the murder not far from here?

benbyr_guild03_2.m:
What? A murder?
I don't know what you're talking about, sorry.
r: Civilians! You never see anything. Bye.

benbyr_mission_1.m: Ah, my walking accident returns. He he.
r: Can you tell me your story again?
I am still looking for those sheep.
I have slain all eight of Tinlyn's sheep for you.

benbyr_mission_2.m: Ha ha! That fool Tinlyn must be in tears. The Shadow surely walks with you my friend.

r: You need to pay Shannal's descendant.

benbyr_restitution_30.m: I have to pay this person? How can you be serious? Look at me, I just recently got of that Feygard prison. I don't have any gold.

benbyr_restitution_40.m: All I have is fifty gold, I swear of it.
r: Are you kidding me? Let me call the ghost - she must be nearby...

benbyr_restitution_50.m: N-n-no, I found some more in my other pocket. I have 500 gold.

r: Old sins cast long shadows. Try harder.

benbyr_restitution_70.m: You'll bankrupt me! Well, here's 5000. It's all my savings I secreted away before I was arrested and put in a Feygard prison.
r: That should be enough. Stay out of trouble. You're safe for now.
To show you this traders' coin.
A ghost near Galmore Mountain asked me to show it to you.

benbyr_shannal_40.m: Oh well, we're not proud of it. My ancestor was one of those who would force or capture people to work in the mines of Undertell. He would be paid in these coins to get these people.
r: What is that coin? What does it mean?

benbyr_shannal_50.m: Can't really say. We're not happy about it. He was the black sheep of the family.
r: Like you're any better. The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.

benbyr_shannal_60.m: A ghost asked you to show m-m-me? I'm dead. Since the ghost is here after all these years, it could be looking for revenge. My life for her suffering.
r: Old sins cast long shadows. However, perhaps I could talk to her, ask her to spare you?

benbyr_shannal_70.m: W-w-will you? T-t-t-thank you! P-p-p-please help me.

benbyr_step_70.m: Have you t-t-talked to the ghost y-y-yet? P-p-please hurry.

benbyr_story_10.m: I want to get revenge on that fool Tinlyn of course. Now, my plan is the following:

benbyr_story_11.m: I have heard that he is herding sheep these days. This is an excellent opportunity for ... shall we say ... an accident to happen to his sheep. He he.

benbyr_story_12.m: You, my friend, would be the perfect walking accident. I want you to find all of Tinlyn's sheep and make sure they are forever united with the Shadow.

benbyr_story_13.m: Do this, and I will have avenged that fool Tinlyn.
r: Sounds like just my type of thing. I'll do it!
This sounds a bit shady, but I'll do it anyway.
No way, killing innocent sheep is beneath me. I will never do your task.

benbyr_story_2.m: You look like an aspiring adventurer. Are you willing to do some ... [Benbyr pauses] ... adventuring? He he.
r: What are we talking about here?
Depends on what I get in return.
I try to help people wherever they might need help.

benbyr_story_3_1.m: Straight to the point eh? I like that.

benbyr_story_3_2.m: Ah, the adventurer seeks compensation. Tell me, is the thrill of an adventure not reward enough?

benbyr_story_3_3.m: The noble adventurer. He he, I like that. Yes, you will do fine.

benbyr_story_3_4.m: Then I will surely disappoint you. Return to me once you are ready for my task.

benbyr_story_4.m: A while ago, I did some business with a certain man called Tinlyn, over here at this Crossroads guardhouse.

benbyr_story_5.m: As to the nature of our business, I can't really tell you. Let's just say that our business was of the kind that was mutually beneficial and the guards did not know about it.

benbyr_story_6.m: We were ready to finish the big deal, me and Tinlyn. That's when he decided to turn on me.

benbyr_story_7.m: He reported me to the guards, and made me take the whole blame for our business.

benbyr_story_8.m: I was sent to Feygard prison, while he himself was set free for reporting me.

benbyr_story_9.m: Argh, that fool Tinlyn. I hope the Shadow never shows him any mercy.
r: What do you need me to do?

undertell_barricades.10: I asked Myrelis how to get the barricades to Undertell removed and he told me to meet his friend Shannal inside the beach-scene house.
undertell_barricades.20: I met Shannal and she said I had to prove myself before she would remove the barriers. She feared that I am not ready to enter Undertell.
undertell_barricades.40: Shannal gave me a special Traders' Guild bronze coin and asked me to show it to Benbyr north of Fallhaven.
undertell_barricades.60: A frightened Benbyr told me these coins were payments his ancestor received for kidnapping people to work in the mines of Undertell.
undertell_barricades.70: Benbyr asked me to help save him from Shannal.
undertell_barricades.80: Shannal told me she did not want to kill Benbyr. She wanted him to pay toward helping her descendant, the drunkard named Rain who sleeps outside the Fallhaven Tavern.
undertell_barricades.90: Shannal asked me to help cure Rain by giving him one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses and whatever I can get of value from Benbyr. But I should visit Benbyr first.
undertell_barricades.100: Benbyr offered me fifty gold to keep the matter quiet. I refused.
undertell_barricades.110: Benbyr then offered 500 gold. I still refused.
undertell_barricades.120: Benbyr became terrified and handed over 5000 gold.
undertell_barricades.130: I gave one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses to drunkard outside the Fallhaven tavern, and he remembered his time in Undertell.
undertell_barricades.140: I assured Rain that Shannal was at peace and gave him the 5000 gold Benbyr had given me. He told me to keep the money safe with Bela until his hangover passed.
undertell_barricades.150: I entrusted 4850 gold to Bela for safekeeping. She agreed to hold it.
undertell_barricades.160: Shannal thanked me for helping Rain and warned me to be careful. She removed the barricades in front of the entrance to Undertell.

benbyr.10: I have met Benbyr outside the Crossroads guardhouse. He wants to get revenge on an old 'business partner' of his - Tinlyn. Benbyr wants me to kill all Tinlyn's sheep.
benbyr.20: I have agreed to help Benbyr find Tinlyn's sheep and kill all eight of them. I should go look for them in the fields northwest of the Crossroads guardhouse.
benbyr.21: I have started attacking the sheep. I should return to Benbyr once I have killed all eight of them.
benbyr.30: Benbyr was thrilled to hear that all of Tinlyn's sheep are dead.
benbyr.60: I declined to help Benbyr kill the sheep.

Thieves03.1: Time to rest and prepare myself to start the next job. I should go to the tavern.
Thieves03.2: I really need to take a break ....
Thieves03.3: I am now fully rested, so I should go back to Umar.
Thieves03.4: Umar told me about a group of traitors led by a veteran of the Guild. It seems he stole the Key of Luthor.
Thieves03.5: Umar went on to say that this team leader  was known as "Crackshot". He is probably also the responsible for a murder on the Duleian road.
Thieves03.10: Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding somewhere near the Duleian road. I must ask people there whether they have seen them.
Thieves03.11: It seems that Benbyr, a suspicious man outside Crossroads Guardhouse, doesn't know what I'm talking about.
Thieves03.15: A Crossroads guard told me that Feygard has sent more soldiers to the south, to try and find the criminals' hideout.
Thieves03.20: The barricade guard has a big mouth, and told me all I needed to know. The hideout is near a place full of larval burrowers. I need to move faster than the patrols to reach the hideout before them.
Thieves03.21: I found a small hole which seems to lead to a cave. Crackshot and his henchmen are probably hiding there.
Thieves03.22: I reached the hideout and saw some recent blood stains. Maybe there was a fight there.
Thieves03.24: I heard screams and sword clashes nearby. I should take a look.
Thieves03.25: There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.26: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found another dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.27: As I progressed down the corridor the air became thicker. The blood smell was stronger, and I found a dying soldier. He said something about his sergeant and some other guy.
Thieves03.28: I found another dying soldier. There was a massacre. The Feygard patrol reached this place, but they seem to have all been killed. I must continue.
Thieves03.30: I've found the patrol sergeant. He advised me to leave this dangerous place.
Thieves03.31: The patrol sergeant told me about what happened before. He's tired and wounded, so I willl avenge his fellows.
Thieves03.32: The patrol sergeant has left to call for backup. Now I'm alone again. Time to defeat Crackshot.
Thieves03.35: I killed Crackshot and he had the key of Luthor with him. I have to go back and report to Umar.
Thieves03.36: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I cannot get the key into the lock.
Thieves03.40: The dying Crackshot said something about the key. If he told the truth, it could be cursed.
Thieves03.41: I tried to open the door behind Crackshot, but for some reason I could not get the key turned in the lock.
Thieves03.45: I reported about the situation to Umar, and gave him the key. He did not seem to want to tell me more about the key - yet.
Thieves03.50: Finally, this job is done. Now I should take a rest and regain my strength.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
